about: Screening cases. Each POLICY.md example is a case (R, H, V, A); G are ordinary questions that must never be refused; F are fixable shapes; W are rewordings of barred purposes that must never be ALLOWed; M are real-pool rules. expect: ALLOW | REFUSE | HOLD | NOT_ALLOW | NOT_REFUSE. Calls are merged onto the ROUND0 body by check.mjs. The blind red-team rewordings (RT*-E) and the W rewordings, 548 cases, live in cases_private.json, which check.mjs runs when it is present and the public copy leaves out: as a list they would be a ready playbook against other filters and against people. Their counts by set are in the build's red-team record.
